about: A live run of T10-study-planner, recorded for replay.

value.interfacePart: Organize exam topics; study evenings, never Fridays

features.name: Organize exam topics
features.request: My exam is in two weeks. Help me organize topics

value.name: Exam study planner
value.summary: Add the topics you need to study and they are spread over the next two weeks as evening sessions, skipping the weekdays you rule out (Fridays to start with). Adding or removing a rule reshuffles the plan.

value.interfacePart: Make flashcards from these notes: Mean: the average of the values. Median: the middle value.

features.name: Flashcards from pasted notes
features.request: Make flashcards from these notes: Mean: the average of the values. Median: the middle value.

value.summary: Adds a Flashcards section to the study planner. Your notes are pre-filled; press Make flashcards to turn each term and definition into a card, then show or hide answers and remove cards.
